== Biography ==

The Nome King rules a kingdom from an underground palace, where he holds captive the wife and ten children of Evoldo, the former King of Ev, having enslaved them there. By his own account, he transformed the Queen of Ev and her children into articles of ornament and bric-a-brac scattered through his apartments, sparing them physical labor — a fate he describes as an act of kindness rather than cruelty, a characterization contested by those who come seeking their release. He also possesses a magic belt, later handed over to Ozma. Tiktok, addressing the assembled Army of Oz on the eve of the campaign against him, describes the Nome King as "hon-est and good na-tured," though this assessment stands at odds with the very expedition mounted to free his prisoners.

From Dorothy's perspective, the Nome King is said to have challenged Ozma to identify the enchanted members of the royal family among his ornaments within a set number of guesses, on pain of Ozma herself being turned into an ornament should she fail.

== Relationships ==

'''[[DOROTHY]]''' — enemy. An exchange accusing him of having been "cheated" suggests hostility between the two.
'''[[Ozma]]''' — enemy. Ozma's assembling of the Army of Oz toward making him "liberate the prisoners" suggests she regards him as an adversary.
'''[[BILLINA]]''' — enemy. A declaration of having "saved you from the Nome King, and you are a slave no longer" suggests Billina acted to free a captive from him.
'''[[Queen of Ev]]''' — enemy. He enslaved her and her ten children and transformed them into ornaments, an act he frames as kindness but which seems to set him against her.
'''[[Scarecrow]]''' — enemy. Their recurring association suggests the Scarecrow, too, stood opposed to him, though no direct exchange between them is given.
